identity: A vast playable grassland world organized around one clear central lake and one north-west watchtower.
spatialComposition: Enter from the south, cross open grass, move around the west shore, and reach the watchtower on a low broad ridge.
environment: Open gently rolling grassland, a continuous natural shoreline, a distant low ridge, and an expansive unobstructed horizon.
lighting: Bright clear daytime with warm directional sunlight and readable long-distance silhouettes.
visualStyle: Cinematic naturalistic landscape with coherent scale; surface detail must never change whitebox topology.
openingShot: Third-person view behind the player, lake centered in the middle ground and the 27 meter tower left of center about 160 meters away.
invariants: Keep exactly one large central lake.
Keep the player, lake and tower in their planned relative positions.
Keep the west route visually and physically open.
